description.narrative: OBJECTIVES 1.To achieve closure of Swedish Funding 2.To put Veritas onto a sound financial footing 3.To continue Veritas work with Parliament, the women's desk and our economic governance work [this is described in the next section] ACTION PLAN 1.Finish off work we did not finish in the last Swedish grant namely completing and printing booklets. 2.Strategic Planning Meetings: •More planning work with our Board of Trustees, involving our trustees in planning and fundraising. •Meeting led by external consultant, focusing on adaptation, revising our vision and our organizational structure to make it fit for purpose. •staff and board planning meeting to develop work plans. 3.Contact a wider range of possible donors, including multilateral institutions, foundations, private funders and corporate donors. 4.Seek organizational funding as a sound basis for carrying out specific projects. 5.Monetize Veritas products, by e.g. soliciting funds from users, and/or charging for specific products/services. 6.Seek funding for taking on climate change issues emphasizing Veritas strengths in legislation. 7.Take a high impact public interest court case on a climate-change issue to draw donors attention to our work. 8.Research into the impact of climate change on women and disadvantaged persons and circulate a white paper on the research and on strategies to ameliorate the impact. 9.Consider regional work e.g. we were asked to help other countries set up Parliamentary monitoring and see if we can get funding for this. 10.Achieve notable successes in our current work women's rights, economic governance, better laws which will make funding Veritas more attractive to donors. NOTE: Activities for the women's desk, for climate change and economic governance are described in the project below. They are included as they point in the direction that Veritas will turn to ensure further funding.

Att bidra till demokratisering, rättssäkerhet, ekonomisk styrning, och kvinnors och marginaliserade människors rättigheter genom medborgares medveteneht och engagemang och stöd till parlamentariker för att de bättre ska fullfölja sina roller inom lagstiftande och ekonomisk styrning.

To advance democracy, the rule of law, economic governance and the rights of women and marginalised people through citizen awareness and engagement and assisting parliamentarians to better fulfil their legislative and economic oversight roles.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
